adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the job does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` with no local `begin/rescue`, so exceptions from `open`/HTTP/DNS/parsing will bubble out of `poll_feed` and fail the scheduled execution. The claim that it has "no timeout" / can hang unbounded is not strictly verifiable from the diff because open-uri/net/http have defaults that may impose timeouts depending on Ruby version/config, but the lack of explicit timeouts and error handling is a concrete robustness/reliability concern introduced by this code.
